HADESANCIENTS-FURNACE_BLAST.title: Furnace Blast
HADESANCIENTS-FURNACE_BLAST.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]{BlastPower}[/blue] [gold]Blast[/gold] and [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the enemy with the lowest HP.
HADESANCIENTS-FURNACE_BLAST.flavor: "Don't like what I see, down comes my hammer just like that!"
HADESANCIENTS-GRAND_CALDERA.title: Grand Caldera
HADESANCIENTS-GRAND_CALDERA.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{BlastPower}[/blue] [gold]Blast[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HADESANCIENTS-GRAND_CALDERA.flavor: "Was as close as I am liable to get to blowing up. Still working at it, mind!"
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVY_METAL.title: Heavy Metal
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVY_METAL.description: At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{ForgeArmorPower}[/blue] [gold]Forge Armor[/gold] and deal damage equal to your [gold]Forge Armor[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-HEAVY_METAL.flavor: "I just had the strongest urge to bang on solid metal for a bit."
HADESANCIENTS-MARTIAL_ART.title: Martial Art
HADESANCIENTS-MARTIAL_ART.description: Whenever a debuff is applied to you, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-MARTIAL_ART.flavor: "Push me around, I'm liable to push right back. And I push harder than you might expect..."
HADESANCIENTS-PREMIUM_SERVICE.title: Premium Service
HADESANCIENTS-PREMIUM_SERVICE.descriptio: Each combat, upgrade the first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] unupgraded cards you draw.
HADESANCIENTS-PREMIUM_SERVICE.flavor: "Reckon you're looking for another tune-up, no problem at all."
HADESANCIENTS-SECURITY_SYSTEM.title: Security System
HADESANCIENTS-SECURITY_SYSTEM.descriptio: On the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns of combat, gain double [gold]Block[/gold] from cards.
HADESANCIENTS-SECURITY_SYSTEM.flavor: "Next I offer you protection, witchie? You'd be wise to take me up on it."
HADESANCIENTS-SMITHY_RUSH.title: Smithy Rush
HADESANCIENTS-SMITHY_RUSH.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]{ForgeArmorPower}[/blue] [gold]Forge Armor[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-TOUGH_GAIN.title: Tough Gain
HADESANCIENTS-TOUGH_GAIN.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP.
HADESANCIENTS-TOUGH_GAIN.flavor: "So you took some hits along the way, so what? You're an extension of your weapon, witchie! And a decent one can take a lot of punishment."
HADESANCIENTS-TRUSTY_SHIELD.title: Trusty Shield
HADESANCIENTS-TRUSTY_SHIELD.flavor: "You got a dangerous line of work, witchie. Though I can get you some protection here."
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.title: Uncanny Fortitude
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.descript: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold] card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] becomes [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold], or such a card is added to your [gold]Deck[/gold], gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.eventDes: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold] card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. (Gain [blue]{TotalHpToGain}[/blue] Max HP.) Whenever a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] becomes [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Enchanted[/gold], or such a card is added to your [gold]Deck[/gold], gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
HADESANCIENTS-UNCANNY_FORTITUDE.flavor: "You still alive, witchie? Here, this ought to keep it that way."
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_STRIKE.title: Volcanic Strike
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_STRIKE.descriptio: The first Attack you play each turn applies [gold]Blast[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_STRIKE.flavor: "You want to see my handiwork, then fine! Might get a wee bit noisy, though."
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_FLOURISH.title: Volcanic Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_FLOURISH.descript: Whenever you play a Skill, apply [blue]{BlastPower}[/blue] [gold]Blast[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-VOLCANIC_FLOURISH.flavor: "Just clanking away as always, though let's do some clanking now on your behalf."
